name: Bitbucket Runner
description: Bitbucket Pipelines self-hosted runner (Docker) pre-installed in a Debian 13 or Ubuntu 24.04 VM. Docker, swap tuning (vm.swappiness=1) and a weekly image prune are configured automatically; the runner container starts on first boot with the credentials you provide.

notes.text: Runner credentials (ACCOUNT_UUID, REPOSITORY_UUID, RUNNER_UUID, OAUTH_CLIENT_ID, OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET) are shown ONLY ONCE in the Bitbucket UI (Workspace/Repo settings > Runners > Add runner > Run step). If lost, create a new runner to get a new command.
The VM automatically disables swap, sets vm.swappiness=1 and schedules a weekly 'docker system prune -af' (Atlassian best practice for runners).
At least 8GB of RAM is recommended. The script warns if you select less than 8192 MiB.
The runner container uses '--restart unless-stopped' and survives VM reboots. Verify with 'docker ps' and 'journalctl -u bitbucket-runner-setup'.
